RegionBehavior.super-fx.senzaEffetti: Super FX effects are not shown inside this region (all of them, or only the chosen ones). Perfect for interiors, caves, tents and roofs.

tipi.label: Effects to remove
tipi.hint: Choose which effects are hidden inside this region. If you choose none, all of them disappear.

Descrizioni.nebbia: Drifting, fraying fog, from light haze to a wall of fog.
Descrizioni.pioggia: From drizzle to storm, with splashes and lightning; also seen from above.
Descrizioni.neve: Flakes dancing in the wind, up to a blizzard.
Descrizioni.sabbia: Wind-driven grains with a veil of dust.
Descrizioni.braci: Rising sparks and glowing ash: fires, forges, volcanoes.
Descrizioni.lucciole: Wandering, pulsing lights: swamps, fey woods, spirits.
Descrizioni.liquido: Rivers, streams, blood, lava, acid or magical energy flowing.
Descrizioni.tromba: Vortex seen from above: air, water, fire or magic. Drag it to move it.
Descrizioni.fulmini: Random flashes and bolts, the same for everyone, with thunder.
Descrizioni.oscurita: A breathing veil of shadow with writhing dark tendrils.

nome.hint: Name of the effect in the panel. If empty, the type is used.

intensita.hint: From 1 (faint) to 5 (extreme): density, amount and strength of the effect.

direzione.hint: Where the wind or current goes: 0° = right, 90° = down, 180° = left, 270° = up.

inclinazione.hint: How much the wind bends the fall. «Straight from above» = falls towards the floor as seen from above, splashing where it lands.

scala.hint: Size of the fog banks or of the current's ripples.

frequenza.hint: How often lightning strikes: from 1 (rare) to 5 (constant).

vaga.hint: 0 = stays at the chosen point; 1 to 5 = roams the area on its own, faster and faster.

schizzi.hint: Water rings or bounces where the drops hit the ground.

lampi.hint: Lightning also strikes during the rain (more often at higher intensity).

sottoToken.hint: The liquid is drawn above the map but below tokens: whoever wades stays visible.

liquido.hint: Kind of liquid: sets the colour and look. Lava, acid and magic glow and bubble.

specie.hint: Air, water, fire or magic: sets the colour and the debris.

suono.hint: Audio file played to everyone shortly after each flash (empty = no sound).

punto.hint: Click the button and then the map; or drag its handle.

area.hint: Where the effect is shown: the whole scene or inside the ticked Regions. «No effects» regions remove it anyway.
area.nessuna: No regions in the scene: draw one with the Region tools to limit the effect.

sfumatura.hint: How soft the edge of the area and of the no-effect zones is, in grid squares.

soloMaster.hint: Only you see it: handy to prepare it before showing it to the players.

larghezza.hint: Thickness of the beams, in grid squares.

scintille.hint: How many sparks fly from the clash and impacts (0 = none).

alMuro.hint: If a wall stands between the source and the end, the beam stops there or passes through.

lunghezzaMax.hint: 0 = when a source moves away the beam always stretches. A number = beyond that many squares the beam breaks, and comes back when the sources get closer.

pulsazione.hint: 0 = steady light; 1 to 5 = the glow breathes faster and faster.

larghezzaBagliore.hint: How far the glow spreads around the wall, in grid squares.

Pannello.nessunEffetto: No effects. Click a button above to add one: it shows up on the map right away.

Raggi.spiega: Select two or more tokens and press «Clash between selected tokens», or create a group and add tokens or free points. Without a target the beams clash with each other; with a target they hit it. When a token or a handle moves, the beams stretch or break at once.
Raggi.nessuno: No beam groups in this scene.
Raggi.nessunaFonte: No sources: add tokens or points.
Raggi.tokenSparito: token no longer in the scene

Muri.spiega: Choose the look of the glow, then select the walls on the Walls layer (Shift + click to pick more than one) and press «Apply».
Muri.stato: Glowing walls in the scene: {luminosi}. Selected walls: {sel}.

Strumenti.zoneSpiega: Effects are removed by Regions with the «Super FX – No effects» behaviour. «Mask from walls» finds rooms, buildings and caves closed by walls by itself and creates the «Super FX – Interiors» region. You can also draw the regions yourself and add the behaviour to the selected ones.
Strumenti.maniglieSpiega: Free beam points and tornado centres have a round handle only you can see: drag it to move them (Shift = snap to the square's centre).
Strumenti.presetSpiega: They add several effects already tuned together to the scene. Then change them as you like.
Strumenti.atmosferaSpiega: Slightly muted colours, deeper shadows and a cold darkness, with the day/night cycle on. «Restore» puts back the previous values.

Domande.svuota: Remove all effects and beams from the scene «{nome}»? Glowing walls stay.

Avvisi.soloMaster: Only the GM can use the Super FX panel.
Avvisi.cliccaMappa: Click on the map to pick the point (Esc or right click to cancel).
Avvisi.scenaTroppoGrande: The scene is too large for the automatic mask: draw the regions by hand.
Avvisi.nessunInterno: No spaces enclosed by walls were found in this scene.
Avvisi.selezionaRegioni: Select one or more regions first (Regions layer).
Avvisi.liquidoArea: Tip: draw a Region along the river, select it and add the liquid; or choose the area in the effect's box.
Avvisi.dueToken: Select at least two tokens (or select one token and target another with T).
Avvisi.selezionaToken: Select one or more tokens first.
Avvisi.prendiDiMira: Target a token (T key) and try again.
Avvisi.selezionaMuri: Select one or more walls first (Walls layer).
Avvisi.nessunMuroLuminoso: None of the selected walls has a glow.
Avvisi.nienteDaRipristinare: There is no previous atmosphere to restore.

lingua.hint: Language of the Super FX texts. «Automatic» follows Foundry's language.

attivo.hint: Turn off to hide the effects on this computer (the others still see them).

qualita.hint: How many particles to draw. Lower it if your computer slows down.

maniglie.hint: GM only: shows the handles of beam points and tornadoes.
